record.question: According to Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines, Goverment of India report, the value of minor minerals produced by the State of Mizoram during 2015-16 was estimated to be
record.explanation: Held: printed page 9 confirms the year 2015-16 and all four supplied amounts. The Indian Bureau of Mines, Indian Minerals Yearbook 2016, Mizoram & Nagaland state review, p. 11-2, reports Rs. 129 lakh for Mizoram in 2015-16 (https://ibm.gov.in/writereaddata/files/01032019095851Mizorumandnagaland2016.pdf), which is absent from the options; Rs. 215 lakh belongs to 2014-15 in the 2015 yearbook, so selecting it would require changing the printed year.
